Module for raster rangelookup.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Rangelookup<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RangeLookup`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster that has to be processed. |
| `pRanges` | String |  |  | The ranges in the form [r1l r1h),[r2l r2h] |
| `pClasses` | String |  |  | The classes to substitute in the same order of the ranges (in the form 1,2) |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The processed raster. |

**Notes**

The ranges are separated by commas, each with its lower and upper bound separated by a space and enclosed in brackets: a square bracket includes the bound, a round one excludes it, and `null` leaves the range open on that side. The classes, also separated by commas, go to the ranges in the same order. For example `[0 10),[10 20),[20 null)` with `1,2,3` gives 1 to the values from 0 to below 10, 2 from 10 to below 20 and 3 from 20 up. The cells that fall in no range become no-data.
